items.title: Japan to support infrastructure recovery in Gulf nations hit by Iran war
Rebuilding Aleppo: Syria's war-torn economic capital enjoys gradual rebirth
items.description: Syria's economic capital Aleppo was left largely in ruins by the fighting that raged there between regime and rebel forces from 2012 to 2016. A 2023 earthquake also caused severe damage to the old city. But reconstruction is now well underway, in particular of Aleppo's treasured historic monuments.

items.title: Israel trucks out Gaza’s rubble to ‘hide genocide’ and ‘redraw the map’
items.description: Israel carts away Gaza's rubble to destroy war crimes evidence and make the landscape unliveable, rights groups say.

items.title: What would a North Korean surge mean for Ukraine war?
items.description: Ukraine is claiming that North Korea is preparing to send tens of thousands more troops to Russia, where they'll gain valuable battlefield experience. President Zelenskyy has urged South Korea to work closer with Kyiv.

items.title: U.S. ambassador calls settler siege of Palestinian homes a 'horrific act of terror'
items.description: The U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee condemned the actions of Jewish settlers who are besieging the home of an American Palestinian family in the Israeli-occupied West Bank.

items.title: With Russia's strikes in Ukraine and hybrid war in Europe, Kyiv's allies face heightened uncertainty
items.description: Russia has stepped up deep strikes in Ukraine and continued its hybrid warfare against Europe, just as US support is faltering. Washington is warning of a possible Russian attack to test Western defenses.

items.title: Why former Soviet states now challenge Russia over Ukraine war
items.description: Former Soviet states in Central Asia are questioning Russia’s war with Ukraine

items.title: More troops to be sent to West Bank village besieged by Israeli settlers
items.description: Two Palestinian families in the village of Qusra say they have been trapped in their homes, with water and power cut off, since Sunday.

items.title: Deadly attack on Red Sea ship adds to global supply chain uncertainty
items.description: A strike on a merchant ship off the southern coast of Yemen that reportedly killed several seafarers on Tuesday threatens to reignite deep concerns about global trade, amid the ongoing Iran-US war that has choked shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Ukraine Repels 185 Combat Clashes on Tuesday
items.description: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) reported 185 combat clashes over the past 24 hours, as Russian forces launched nearly 6,770 drones and 208 guided aerial bombs (KABs) nationwide.

items.title: Ukrainian Ground Drones Run Supplies, Evacuate Wounded Under Russian Fire
items.description: RFE/RL followed soldiers from Ukraine’s 117th Mechanized Brigade as they deployed ground drones to frontline positions in the Donetsk region. The unmanned vehicles carry ammunition and supplies across roads exposed to Russian drones.

items.title: One Killed in Ukrainian Attack on Wildberries Logistics Center in Voronezh
items.description: The online retailer said it evacuated employees from the facility after a fire broke out during the overnight drone strikes.
